topic: Making good slides with AI: Claude (file creation, the Slides template, Claude for PowerPoint), Gamma, Claude then Gamma, and a team standard
audience: Beginners at work who build presentations and want AI to do the heavy lifting without the deck looking generic
goal: Pick one of three methods, build a real deck with it from a solid storyline, and set up a shared standard (template, instructions, theme) a team can reuse
notes: Claude can create Excel (.xlsx), PowerPoint (.pptx), Word (.docx) and PDF files in a conversation; you can download them or save them directly to Google Drive. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/12111783-create-and-edit-files-with-claude]

To get a deck file, you ask in plain language, for example 'Convert this document into a PowerPoint presentation', and Claude generates a file you download from the conversation. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/12111783-create-and-edit-files-with-claude]
The file-creation article gives a maximum of 30MB per file for uploads and downloads. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/12111783-create-and-edit-files-with-claude]

Code execution and file creation is available to all users (Free through Enterprise) on web, desktop and mobile, and it is on by default for Free, Pro, Max and Ultra. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/12111783-create-and-edit-files-with-claude]

Artifacts require the code execution and file creation setting ('Create and edit files' in the updated layout) to be on in Settings > Capabilities. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/17153992-what-are-artifacts-and-how-do-i-use-them]
Anthropic's built-in skills handle Excel, Word, PowerPoint and PDF creation and are used automatically when relevant. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/12512180-use-skills-in-claude]

An artifact is anything Claude makes that you'd put in front of someone (a design, deck, document, dashboard or small interactive tool); it opens beside the conversation and can be edited and shared. Artifacts are on all plans. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/17153992-what-are-artifacts-and-how-do-i-use-them]

The Docs, Slides and Design templates are on all plans. To start from a template: ask for one in any chat, select 'Output' in the message box and choose a template, or pick one in the Artifacts tab. Slides are presentations built from your notes, reports or the work already in your chat. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/17153992-what-are-artifacts-and-how-do-i-use-them]

Claude Slides presentations can be edited slide by slide (by talking to Claude or directly), presented inside Claude ('Present'), and exported: decks go to PowerPoint or PDF, or straight to Google Slides as editable files, via 'Export'. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/17153992-what-are-artifacts-and-how-do-i-use-them]

Claude for PowerPoint is a PowerPoint add-in; its documentation says it is generally available to Pro, Max, Team and Enterprise plans (not Free). claude.com's Microsoft 365 page says the add-ins are on all paid plans. [https://claude.com/docs/office-agents/powerpoint] [https://claude.com/claude-for-microsoft-365]

Supported versions: PowerPoint on Windows with a Microsoft 365 subscription, build 16.0.13127.20296 or later, and PowerPoint on Mac, version 16.46 or later. [https://claude.com/docs/office-agents/powerpoint]

To install Claude for PowerPoint: go to the 'Claude for Microsoft 365' listing on Microsoft AppSource, select 'Get it now', then open PowerPoint, activate the add-in (Tools > Add-ins on Mac, Home > Add-ins on Windows) and sign in with your Claude account. [https://claude.com/docs/office-agents/powerpoint]
To build a whole deck, open a blank deck and describe your goal; Claude builds a draft with a logical structure that you then refine. [https://claude.com/docs/office-agents/powerpoint]

Claude for PowerPoint reads the deck's slide master, layouts, fonts and colour scheme and uses them; it builds slides in your templates, makes pinpoint edits to specific slides, and converts bullets into diagrams and native PowerPoint charts, which stay editable. [https://claude.com/docs/office-agents/powerpoint]

Persistent instructions in Claude for PowerPoint: open Settings in the add-in sidebar and use the Instructions field; they apply to every conversation in PowerPoint. [https://claude.com/docs/office-agents/powerpoint]

Claude prices: Free $0 (includes file creation, Artifacts and Claude Slides); Pro $20 per month billed monthly or $17 per month billed annually ($200 up front); Pro adds Projects and Claude in Microsoft 365. Team Standard seats cost $20 per seat per month billed annually or $25 monthly, for teams of 2 to 150. Prices exclude tax and may change. [https://claude.com/pricing]
Anthropic positions Sonnet 5.5 as strongest at well-scoped everyday tasks and creating polished documents, slides and spreadsheets. [https://www.anthropic.com/claude-sonnet-5-5]

To create a Claude project, go to claude.ai/projects and click '+ New Project'; add files with '+' and instructions with 'Set project instructions'. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/9519177-how-can-i-create-and-manage-projects]

To add a custom skill, package the skill folder as a ZIP, go to Customize > Skills, click '+', then '+ Create skill' and 'Upload a skill'. Skills are on all plans and need code execution. [https://support.claude.com/en/articles/12512180-use-skills-in-claude]

Gamma's plans are Free, Plus, Pro, Ultra and Business. The help article lists plan features and credits but no prices. [https://help.gamma.app/en/articles/8077107-how-can-i-upgrade-my-gamma-subscription]

Gamma Free includes AI creations, the AI Agent, basic image models, up to 10 slides per prompt and 50k input tokens; free credits don't refresh, but you earn 200 per referral and can hold up to 2,000. [https://help.gamma.app/en/articles/8077107-how-can-i-upgrade-my-gamma-subscription]

Gamma Plus gives 1,500 monthly credits, removes the 'Made with Gamma' badge from shared or exported content, adds advanced image models and allows up to 100 slides per prompt. [https://help.gamma.app/en/articles/8077107-how-can-i-upgrade-my-gamma-subscription]

Gamma Pro gives 4,000 monthly credits, API access, headers/footers and password protection, premium image models, custom domains and detailed viewer analytics. Gamma Ultra gives 20,000 monthly credits. [https://help.gamma.app/en/articles/8077107-how-can-i-upgrade-my-gamma-subscription]

Gamma bills per user; all AI actions (presentations, images, AI-agent edits) use credits; unused credits roll over up to double the plan size. Upgrade in Settings > Billing > View all plans. [https://help.gamma.app/en/articles/8077107-how-can-i-upgrade-my-gamma-subscription]

Creating in Gamma starts with a conversation with an agent: describe what you want in the prompt bar on your dashboard (paste notes, attach files, choose a template). Modes in the mode picker: Plan (default; the agent asks a few questions, shows its plan and waits for your go-ahead), Express (skips questions and plan, straight to a draft) and Research (deep web research first, more credits, Pro and above, only with Plan). You can choose 'Decide for me' on any question. [https://help.gamma.app/en/articles/15002203-how-do-i-create-with-agent-in-gamma]

In Gamma, you change a deck by telling the agent in the chat in your own words (e.g. 'Slide 4 is too text-heavy - make it more visual'), or edit by hand. To change the look without changing content, ask for a new look: the agent offers style directions and restyles in place; regenerating starts the content over. [https://help.gamma.app/en/articles/15002203-how-do-i-create-with-agent-in-gamma]

Already have your text? Paste it into Gamma and ask the agent to keep your wording and make one slide per section; mark where each slide starts with three dashes (---). The classic generator offers 'Preserve this exact text'. Options include 'Don't add images' and 'Image placeholders'. [https://help.gamma.app/en/articles/15002203-how-do-i-create-with-agent-in-gamma] [https://help.gamma.app/en/articles/7838093-how-do-i-create-a-new-presentation-document-or-webpage-in-gamma]

Gamma imports PowerPoint (.pptx, .potx), Word (.docx) and PDF files, Google Slides (as .pptx or a view link) and webpages. Click Import below the prompt box, then Add a file, to bring a file in as-is with layouts intact. [https://help.gamma.app/en/articles/11047840-how-can-i-import-slides-or-content-into-gamma]

Gamma exports to PDF, PNG, PowerPoint (PPTX) and Google Slides: click Share (top right) then Export, or the three-dot menu then Export. Choose All cards to export the full deck. Exports match Present Mode. Tables export to PowerPoint as editable tables by default. [https://help.gamma.app/en/articles/8022861-what-s-the-easiest-way-to-export-my-gamma]

Gamma themes: a Theme is a saved look the whole workspace can reuse (colours, fonts, logo); Styles are one gamma's own copy. To build a theme from your company deck: in the left sidebar go to Customize > Themes, click + New Theme, select Import file and upload a .pptx or Google Slides file; review the detected name, accent colour, background, fonts and logo, then Save and finish. To save a gamma's look: Styles > Themes > Save as new theme. [https://help.gamma.app/en/articles/11029150-how-do-i-customize-themes-colors-and-fonts-in-gamma]

Gamma workspace templates turn any gamma into a reusable template, on all plans including Free: Templates tab in the left sidebar > + Add a gamma > Create template > Save copy as template; teammates hover a template and choose Use template. [https://help.gamma.app/en/articles/12590858-how-do-i-use-workspace-templates]

Gamma template instructions embed AI guidance in a template (template-level in Template settings > Instructions; slide-level sticky notes; slides can be Locked). They are available on Pro and Ultra, not yet on Team or Business plans, and only affect AI generation. [https://help.gamma.app/en/articles/16056626-what-are-template-instructions-and-how-can-i-use-them]

Gamma workspace custom instructions (Customize > Custom Instructions, admins only) apply brand rules to everyone's generations; they are Enterprise-only. Personal custom instructions are available to all users. Absolute wording ('always', 'never') is treated as a firm rule. [https://help.gamma.app/en/articles/16951204-how-do-i-set-up-workspace-custom-instructions]
